en.hubeali:
And by this chain, said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘When you perform part of your Ablution (Wudhu), so a need arises for you until your Ablution (Wudhu) dries up, so repeat your Ablution (Wudhu), for the Ablution (Wudhu) cannot be in parts’.
en.sarwar: 7. Through the chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith is the following narration: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If while taking Wudu’ something happens that keeps you busy and your Wudu’ dries up, you must do your Wudu 5 again; it is not permissible to divide WuduY”
